plan: Given my value of $26, I need to bid high enough to win against likely bids, but not so high that I overpay. Since it's round 1 and there's no history, I'll assume other bidders will bid somewhat randomly. A conservative approach is to bid slightly above the midpoint of possible values. I'll bid $23. This aims to win if others bid low, and avoids overpaying if others are aggressive. It balances risk and reward.

Since this is a single-round auction with only three bidders, a conservative approach is best. My value is $21. I estimate others will bid somewhat aggressively.
